description: Free for up to 3 domains per call. Report what changed in SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI since a previous run. Pass the `snapshots` object returned by the previous call as `previous`; the server stores nothing. The first call returns a baseline with no changes.

previous.description: The `snapshots` object from the previous call, or omit on the first run

name: monitor_sending_domains
